verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a dedicated Email API endpoint for sending transactional email asynchronously and offers official libraries in several languages, so the core single-call send capability is there. The pack does not show the request's required fields, any quickstart code, or what the response returns. Missing for 10: documented minimal required fields, copy-paste quickstart code sample, evidence that a message id is returned for tracking, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a transactional email with one documented API call — minimal required fields, copy-paste quickstart code, and a message id back for tracking

citations.quote: This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
transactional emails can be sent through MailerSend’s Email API or using SMTP relay.
MailerSend supports this list of official libraries for your favorite programming language.
